data.body:
INVESTIGATION_ENVELOPE: Phase D Step 4

ROOT_CAUSE: v4 (PR #527) removed the DSO-Story-Merge trailer self-attestation shortcut from verify-session-provenance.sh (lines 415-426). Every commit now requires GitHub PR API verification via 'gh api repos/{owner}/commits/{sha}/pulls' + G3 check-run verification. Tests 1-4 in test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh have no mock gh binary — the real gh CLI is called with SHAs that don't exist on GitHub, returning 404 errors. verify-session-provenance.sh treats gh API failures as unprovenanced (lines 483-487), so all 5 story commits are flagged unprovenanced. This causes exit 1, not 0.

Test 5 (negative control) also fails: the dispatcher wrapper (llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh) requires origin/main to be resolvable (line 329-334) when it has unprovenanced SHAs to filter. The fixture repo has no remotes, so 'git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main' fails, wrapper exits 1 before calling the runner.

AFFECTED_FILES:
- tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh (ONLY test file needs changes)
- plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh (DO NOT modify — correct v4 behavior)
- plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh (DO NOT modify — correct v4 behavior)

FIX_PLAN:
1. Add _build_mock_gh_provenanced_bin helper to test file — creates a mock gh that:
   - For 'gh api .../commits/{sha}/pulls': returns [{'number':42,'state':'closed','merged_at':'2024-01-01T00:00:00Z','merge_commit_sha':'0000000000000000000000000000000000000000','head':{'sha':'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'}}]
   - For 'gh api .../commits/{cov_head_sha}/check-runs': returns {'check_runs':[{'name':'review-sub-pr','conclusion':'success'}]}
   - For other gh api calls: returns '[]'
2. Expose FIXTURE_MOCK_BIN from _build_large_provenanced_fixture (mock bin dir)
3. Set up local origin/main in _build_large_provenanced_fixture for wrapper compat
4. Update tests 1-4 to pass PATH=FIXTURE_MOCK_BIN:PATH to verifier/wrapper calls
5. Update test 5 to add a bare-clone origin remote so origin/main resolves — the base commit must be on origin/main while new commits (unprovenanced) are NOT, so comm filter keeps them in scope

RED_TEST_REPRO:
Run: bash tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh
Expected: 1 pass, 6 fails (tests 1,2,3,4,5,5b)
Actual (current): exactly that — PASSED: 1 FAILED: 6

GREEN_EXPECTED:
After fix: PASSED: 7 FAILED: 0

COMPLEXITY: MODERATE
FIXABLE: YES
MANUAL_APPROVAL_NEEDED: NO (test-only fix, no logic changes)
COMPLEX_ESCALATION: NO
SCRATCH_KEY: fix-bug:investigation
